scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n frontend,backend,worker,stripe-webhooks "pnpm dev:frontend" "pnpm dev:backend" "pnpm dev:worker" "pnpm dev:stripe:optional"
scripts.start:backend: cd backend && uv run python -u -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --no-access-log
scripts.start:worker: cd backend && uv run python -u -m scripts.run_analysis_worker
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run python -u -m scripts.dev_server
scripts.dev:worker: cd backend && uv run python -u -m scripts.run_analysis_worker
scripts.dev:stripe:optional: pnpm dev:stripe || echo Stripe webhook listener unavailable - run pnpm dev:stripe to diagnose
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check .
